{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]

# Exclude internal test orders from completed orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_completed['revenue_float'].sum()

print(f"Number of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99) in completed set: {len(internal_test_orders)}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders excluding internal test orders: {total_revenue}")"}
